I have recorded a video which covers the coding vignette at the end of Chapter 3 on fitting linear regression models using the 'statsmodels' package. I talk about the
purpose of 'statsmodels' and contrast it with 'sklearn', and then go over the basic syntax, illustrating how to utilize the model summaries and plotting routines
to interpret linear regression models. The book provides a python notebook which covers this content and which I largely followed, but I have my own notebook which
includes my comments on the material, in case you find an alternative perspective helpful. Stay tuned for a soon to be uploaded bonus video on the material that
was not covered at the end of Meetup 3 (I recorded it once but the recording did not capture any audio).

You can find the ['statsmodels video here](https://youtu.be/DlQgKi6nESw)

You can download my python notebook here: [statsmodels vignette ](https://github.com/georgehagstrom/DATA622Fall2026/blob/main/website/meetups/meetup-3/sm-vignette.ipynb)
